change: Validate nonempty bootstrap block ranges using subtraction instead of overflow-prone start + count, for both the RAM disk and VirtIO-backed range.

checks.result: pass under ASan/UBSan for valid boundaries, empty ranges, out-of-range sectors and unsigned wraparound
pass: desktop boot and existing bootstrap block selftest, wrapping bootstrap BlkRead and BlkWrite requests and oversized count rejected; zstatus failed=0

scope: PCI QEMU uses a disposable disk clone. Host range tests cover RAM-disk boundary arithmetic, but an invalid RAM-disk request was not executed inside the guest. This does not fix DebugDemo break handling.
